reason: Retain 55 production and 77 test files for the shared research flow. Registry, Discovery, Crawler and FetchBudget have explicit resource lifetimes; interactive search and warming share only their runtime instances. Provider adapters, ranking, text extraction and tool admission remain separate file boundaries because they compose the same egress, secret-screening and index contracts. Isolation, cancellation, pacing, redirect and fetch-content tests support this boundary.
